head: TypeDraw lets you type in your own handwriting
dek: TypeDraw is a notebook app where you can even type in your own handwriting, with notes kept on your device or synced through your own iCloud. It was #28 among all paid apps on the UK App Store on 3 November.
details: No account and no subscription are needed. It costs £4.99 with in-app purchases, by Trautmann & Dorre.
means: If you like handwritten notes but type faster, it gives you both.
todo: Find TypeDraw in the App Store.
